summary: Static site constants module. It exports the main navigation list (main, character, video, news, world, feature entries with Chinese labels, mi18n keys nav1/nav2/navVideo/nav3/nav5/nav4 and tracking keys), the 13 supported locale codes, a per-section parallax animation config (yPercent/xPercent tweens for `.fill-bg`, `.fill-text`, `.section-character`, `.fill-black-bar-feature`), the default language `en-us`, the `lang` storage/query key, and a list of route paths/regexes (`/xbox`, `/main`, `/company/privacy`, `/company/terms*`, `/news/<id>`) used for path matching.

exports.e: main navigation items (label, link, mi18nKey, miaKey)
exports.f: per-home-section parallax animation config (element selector + tween attrs)
exports.a: list of route paths / regexes matched by path helpers
